summary: HCI Group filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 to disclose the entry into reinsurance agreements for the 2026-2027 treaty year. The filing details three reinsurance towers covering its insurance subsidiaries and reciprocal exchanges, involving private reinsurers and the Florida Hurricane Catastrophe Fund. No specific financial terms (price per share, premium, etc.) are provided as this is an ordinary business arrangement to manage catastrophe risk. The filing is a routine material definitive agreement, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisors are named. Watch for hurricane season exposure, but no risk-arb angle applies.
